verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is documented as a self-hosted platform that runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal), fully offline, or air-gapped. The deployer therefore controls where data physically resides. That residency control comes only from choosing your own deployment location; the product documents no explicit data-residency or region-selection feature or storage-location configuration. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region controls, documentation of where chat/file data is stored and how to configure storage location, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal)
self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
